review_candidates.title: Mission Head
review_candidates.description: The Organisation Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected. Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge. For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries. We won’t stop until we are all equal. The Opportunity Plan International is responding to the humanitarian situation in Venezuela through a principled, partner-led model. The organisation works with vetted national and international partners and local consultants, supported by the Regional Office for the Americas and global technical functions. Following the June 2026 earthquakes, the response has expanded rapidly from existing protection, education, health, MHPSS and WASH partnerships into a multi-sector humanitarian operation. Current priorities include shelter and non-food items, food assistance, WASH, Child Protection in Emergencies, Education in Emergencies, and health/MHPSS referral pathways. Delivery is localised and partner-led, with Plan providing strategic direction, technical oversight, safeguarding, compliance, MEAL and accountability, coordination, resource mobilisation and donor reporting. The role will guide the transition from emergency scale-up toward a sustainable, compliant and locally anchored country presence. Role Purpose The Head of Mission will provide strategic, organisational and external leadership for Plan International’s work in Venezuela. The postholder will be accountable for the quality, relevance, sustainability and integrity of the country portfolio and will lead the establishment of the operating model, governance arrangements, organisational capabilities and partnerships required for Plan to deliver lasting impact for children and adolescents, especially girls. During the initial phase, the Head of Mission will lead a partner-led humanitarian response in which Plan’s role centres on technical and operational accompaniment, quality assurance, partner capacity strengthening, safeguarding, compliance, humanitarian coordination, resource mobilisation, MEAL/AAP and donor-grade reporting. Dimensions of the role Senior organisational representative for Venezuela, responsible for institutional positioning, credibility and relationships with authorities, UN agencies, donors, diplomatic actors, civil society, partners and peer organisations. Executive accountability for the Venezuela country strategy and humanitarian response, including a phased multi-sector portfolio delivered primarily through local and national partners. Leadership of an evolving country structure spanning programmes, humanitarian response, operations, finance, people and culture, security, safeguarding, MEAL, business development, communications and partnerships. Accountability for organisational risk, legal and regulatory compliance, , partner assurance, financial stewardship, safeguarding and staff/consultant duty of care. Essential Requirements Previous Country Director, Head of Mission, Response Director or equivalent experience. Substantial senior leadership experience in an international humanitarian, development or rights-based organisation, including accountability for a country programme, major response, complex portfolio or comparable business unit. Demonstrated success leading humanitarian response and recovery programming in fragile, politically sensitive or access-constrained contexts. Strong understanding of child-centred humanitarian programming, protection, gender equality and inclusion, safeguarding, accountability to affected populations and localisation. strengthening, performance management, compliance, and equitable decision-making. Experience establishing or transforming country operations, organisational systems, legal/registration arrangements or complex remote/hybrid operating models. Strong financial and business management capability, including portfolio budgeting, forecasting, grants management, donor compliance, risk management, and cost recovery. Proven resource-mobilisation and external representation experience with institutional donors, UN agencies, diplomatic actors, government counterparts, civil society and peer organisations. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop diverse, multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams in high-pressure environments. Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation and influencing skills in Spanish and English. Location: The role is expected to be based primarily in Caracas. The role requires extensive travel to programme areas, partner offices, collective sites and coordination meetings, including locations with disrupted infrastructure and elevated security or environmental risks. All travel and field activity are subject to Plan’s security management and clearance procedures. Type of Role: Initial 12 month unaccompanied contract, possible extension. This is a global search and relocation support is available. Reports to: Regional Director, Region of the Americas Closing Date: Sunday 9th August. review_candidates.description: Een missie die er toe doet Om de klimaatdoelen te halen heeft Nederland zich gecommitteerd aan het realiseren van CO₂-arme elektriciteit. Nucleaire Energie Organisatie Nederland (NEO NL) draagt hieraan bij door in opdracht van de overheid twee nieuwe kerncentrales te bouwen en te exploiteren. Waarschijnlijk krijg je maar één keer in je leven de kans om mee te werken aan een opgave waarvan de omvang en het maatschappelijk belang zó groot zijn. Bij NEO NL werk je mee aan een van de grootste energieprojecten die ons land ooit gekend heeft. Met jouw werk maak je impact die decennialang voelbaar blijft. Om deze opgave tot een succes te maken, hebben we uitzonderlijke mensen nodig. Mensen zoals jij. Voor NEO NL zijn wij op zoek naar een Medior Project support / Jr. Project manager. Jouw opdracht Jij speelt een cruciale rol in het soepel laten verlopen van ons ambitieuze programma. Je ondersteunt de programma- en projectmanagers over de volle breedte en zorgt voor heldere samenhang, structuur en overzicht. Als verbindende schakel tussen de verschillende projecten en programma's bewaak jij feilloos de interfaces. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat alle belangrijke informatie tijdig, volledig en eenduidig wordt gedeeld. Je coördineert de gestandaardiseerde PMO-planning, bewaakt de voortgang en stelt heldere rapportages op. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan het continu verbeteren van onze processen en werkwijzen. Je signaleert risico’s en knelpunten in een vroeg stadium en vertaalt deze direct naar concrete acties. Met jouw gestructureerde aanpak, scherpe blik en proactieve houding zorg je voor een effectief functionerend programma, waarbij alle betrokkenen optimaal worden gefaciliteerd in het behalen van de gezamenlijke doelstellingen. Jouw achtergrond en ervaring Jij hebt een succesvol afgeronde opleiding in het hoger onderwijs (hbo of wo). Jij brengt minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring mee als junior projectleider, projectondersteuner of in een PMO-rol. Jij bent zeer bedreven in het gebruik van de standaard MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) en projectmanagementtools zoals JIRA en MS Project. Jij beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend, zowel in woord als geschrift. Daarnaast waarderen wij het als je beschikt over Ervaring met bekende projectmanagementmethodieken zoals PRINCE2 of IPMA. Basis programmeervaardigheden en/of ervaring met PowerBI (dit zien wij als een sterke pre). Competenties Analytisch en strategisch inzicht: Jij doorgrondt complexe informatie razendsnel, scheidt moeiteloos het kaf van het koren en vertaalt dit naar strategische inzichten die passen bij een strikte veiligheidscultuur. Organisatorische kracht: Jij werkt uiterst gestructureerd, brengt orde in de chaos en stelt prioriteiten met uiterste precisie. Stressbestendigheid: Jij opereert soepel en effectief in een dynamische en complexe omgeving, waarbij je altijd het overzicht weet te behouden. Assertiviteit: Jij staat stevig in je schoenen, durft kritisch te zijn en schroomt niet om een eigen standpunt in te nemen. Verbindende communicatie: Jij bent proactief, communiceert helder en weet op een effectieve manier samen te werken met diverse stakeholders binnen en buiten de organisatie. Wat wij bieden Een sterk en betrokken team – Word onderdeel van een divers en ambitieus team van 100 professionals die één gezamenlijk doel en een gedeelde missie hebben. Een cultuur van vertrouwen en eigenaarschap – Wij geloven in verantwoordelijkheid, samenwerking, open communicatie en een veilige werksfeer. Een dynamische omgeving – Ervaar de energie die vrijkomt bij het stap voor stap opbouwen van de organisatie en de twee kerncentrales die Nederland vele decennia vooruithelpen. Over de organisatie NEO NL is een zelfstandige organisatie waarvan het ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat de enige aandeelhouder is. Onze missie is helder: het leveren van duurzame kernenergieoplossingen die bijdragen aan de Nederlandse ambitie van klimaatneutraliteit. Met ongeëvenaarde kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen, en gedreven door expertise en verantwoordelijkheid, bouwen we aan een veerkrachtig energiesysteem en bevorderen we nucleaire kennis voor toekomstige generaties. Bij NEO NL heb je niet zomaar een baan. Je krijgt een once-in-a-life-time kans om ervoor te zorgen dat Nederland minder afhankelijk wordt van de import van fossiele brandstoffen en beschikt over schone en betrouwbare energie. Je wordt onderdeel van een ambitieus, ondersteunend en internationaal team dat werkt op het snijvlak van beleid, technologie en samenleving. Dit is jouw kans om geschiedenis te schrijven. Sluit je bij ons aan en maak deel uit van iets dat blijvend is. Meer weten? review_candidates.title: Manager Planning & Scheduling
review_candidates.description: A mission that matters To achieve its climate goals, the Netherlands is committed to achieving carbon-free electricity. Nuclear Energy Organisation Netherlands (NEO NL) contributes to this by building and operating two new nuclear power plants on behalf of the government. It is one of the most ambitious energy projects the Netherlands has ever seen. At NEO NL, your work will directly contribute to this national ambition and make an impact that lasts for decades. To make this assignment a success, we need extraordinary people. People like you. For the start-up phase of NEO NL, we are looking for a Manager Planning & Scheduling. Your assignment As Manager Planning & Scheduling, you lead a team of Planners & Schedulers embedded in the programmes and projects. You will oversee, guide, challenge, and support so that each programme and project delivery team works to a consistent, current, logically sound Plan & Schedule, and programme control rests on reliable schedule data and analysis. You report to the Head of Project Controls and work closely with the Cost Management, Risk Management, and Change Management functions of Project Controls. Leading the Planning & Scheduling team: You lead and develop the team of planners & schedulers and ensure the quality, consistency, and timeliness of all scheduling information the team produces. Planning standards: You set the standards, policies, and procedures for the scheduling discipline, improve planning methods, data governance, and traceability, and play an active part in the transition to Primavera P6 (data, structure, reporting). Developing and maintaining the schedule: You build and maintain the schedule for your scope, defining WBS, coding, and activity logic that give a sound foundation for long-term control, and keep it current, logically sound, and an accurate reflection of progress. Progress coordination and analysis: You gather progress inputs across the disciplines and run critical path, trend, and variance analysis, so schedule risks and slippage are flagged before they hit the critical path. Scenario and resource analysis: You build workload, resource, and alternative-execution scenarios so PMs clearly understand and can make fact-based decisions, as well as seeing the consequences of different option Schedule integration: You integrate the schedules of multiple disciplines and contractors into one coherent, realistic plan, and work with delivery teams to keep plans coordinated and achievable. Reporting: You produce clear, timely progress and performance reports and KPI views for the delivery teams, PMO, and management, and establish the reporting protocols that give senior leaders accurate trends, forecasts, and recommendations. Your Background And Experience A bachelor's or master's degree in a business or technical field. 15 to 20 years of Planning & Scheduling experience across large CAPEX/mega-projects in construction, energy, or infrastructure. 5 to 10 years of managerial experience. Advanced Primavera P6 user with strong command of schedule logic and data management. Strong grasp of resource planning, critical path analysis, QSRA, and earned value management. Experience assessing supply-chain schedules and performing schedule impact analysis of change. Able to integrate multiple discipline and contractor schedules into one coherent plan, and to translate complex schedule analysis into clear updates for PMs and programme management. Able to challenge senior stakeholders and hold them accountable for scheduling-related activities. Competencies Leadership: You give direction to your team, develop people, and make sure the work the team delivers is transparent, auditable, consistent, and understood by the project delivery teams, the Management Team, and stakeholders. Analytical strength: You diagnose the causes of slippage and build credible scenarios, even where there is no single right answer. Influence: You hold senior stakeholders to account for their part in the schedule and stand by what the data shows. Rigour: You safeguard the integrity of schedule data, because sound decisions in a nuclear environment start with reliable information. Connector: You bring disciplines, contractors, and delivery teams together behind one realistic schedule. What We Offer A strong and committed team: Become part of a diverse and ambitious team of professionals who share a common goal and mission. A culture of trust and ownership: We believe in responsibility, collaboration, open communication, and a safe working environment. Dynamic environment: Experience the energy of building a new organisation step by step, and two nuclear power plants that will help the Netherlands for many decades from now. About The Organisation NEO NL is a state-owned company. Our mission is clear: deliver long-lasting nuclear energy solutions that support the Dutch ambition of climate neutrality. With unmatched standards of quality and safety, and driven by deep expertise and responsibility, we are creating a resilient energy system while advancing nuclear knowledge for generations to come. At NEO NL, you won't just have a job; you will have a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to ensure the Netherlands becomes less dependent on fossil fuels and to have clean and reliable energy for generations to come. You will be part of an ambitious, supportive, and international team, working at the forefront of policy, technology, and society. This is your chance to make history. Join us and be part of something that lasts. Work location: The Hague, Carel van Bylandtlaan 5. Want to know more? Contact our Talent Acquisition Specialist, Abel Willemse, at a.h.j.willemse@minezk.nl. More information: www.neonl.com.
